segments.he:
(וּכְעֵין זֶה מְבאָר  בִּדְבָרָיו  זִכְרוֹנוֹ
לִבְרָכָה). הֵשִׁיב לוֹ רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה, אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ  מַה  הוּא  לֵב  וּמַה  הוּא  ערֶף  (דִי
וֵוייסְט וֶועלִיכֶעס עֶס אִיז הַארְץ אָדֶער אִין אַקִין):
segments.en: (162.) I heard in his name o.b.m. that he said: "Even if one is not a proper man — even so it is very good for him that he draws close to the tzaddik." And about this the Tanna warned [Avos 2]: "And do not be wicked before yourself" — that even if he is, G-d forbid, wicked — he should not be wicked before himself. Rather he too should endeavor to draw close to the tzaddik — so that he should at least have some end and hope.
